label: weak: late input a in sequences starting with d/a
explanation: Very sparse feature (286 dev steps). Fires only near the end of the original phase (t=6-9, mostly the last 1-2 original tokens of L=8-9 sequences) and at the <DEL> step; never in the copy phase or before t=5. Activations are concentrated in sequences whose first token is d (65% of mass) or a (30%), and the strongest ones are on an input a late in the sequence, often right after a 2 (top: d a h o 3 c 2 [a]). But most late a inputs in d/a-initial sequences do not activate it (precision ~0.16), and about half the mass is on other tokens and <DEL>. Best predicate (d/a first token, input a, t>=7) gets dev F1 0.20 and mass recall 0.41. No coherent rule found.
